harness.note: Exactly the configuration scripts/build_shackleton_anchor.py ships the anchor world with, so the validated numbers are the numbers the published bundle carries - not a bespoke, better-tuned run. A PSR fraction is only meaningful together with the window that defines 'permanent' (PsrEpochSemantics.SEASONAL here).

reference.source: LOLA GDR LPSR_85S_060M_201608.IMG (PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0; NASA PGDA 'Lunar Polar Illumination' product 69) - a published binary permanently-shadowed flag map at 60 m/px, 85-90S polar stereographic (R = 1737.4 km). Its PSR determination is the method of Mazarico, E., Neumann, G.A., Smith, D.E., Zuber, M.T., Torrence, M.H. (2011), 'Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography', Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030 - horizon-based illumination over several 18.6-year lunar precession cycles.
